fields.description:
# BA-1: BA Object + Core Status

_Foundational Brand Ambassador object — status picklist, market fields, and the manager lookup everything else depends on._

### FIELDS

* BA Status — Picklist: Active, Paused, Inactive, Terminated. Trimmed from an initial five-value list that included a Review status.
* Brand Manager — Lookup, required. A BA without a Brand Manager is excluded from roll-up reporting.
* Primary Market
* Secondary Markets — Multi-select picklist. Field type and value list not yet settled; not confirmed these fields exist on the User object today — may need to be created.
* Start Date — Date, required
* End Date — Date, automation-set when the BA is terminated (see BUILD-206, BA-5)

### IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS

* No separate "Review Required" status — a BA either keeps working or gets terminated, not left in limbo.
* Total Sign-Ups roll-up is removed; standard reports cover this instead of a custom roll-up object.
* Not confirmed — hold before building: the mapping of Active/Paused/Terminated against the User object's Active checkbox. See [BUILD-236 — Brand Ambassador: Status Automation (via User Active Checkbox)](https://app.asana.com/0/0/1217832880216788/f/).

### NOTES

* Provenance: BA-1 (Brand Ambassador Record User Stories doc).
* Open question carried from the doc: is a separate "flagged for review" marker still needed once Review Required is dropped as a status (mirroring Player's Review Required checkbox, PL-7)? Not confirmed either way.

### SOURCE

* [Taryn doc BA-1 — Brand Ambassador Record User Stories](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MsJXwt3oY-DyQuAdMzNYlyPenKUQl7g8mHzMmeRaVHs/edit?tab=t.g64hrhse8pog)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 47:03 (four statuses)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=2823)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 53:01 (brand manager lookup)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3181)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 58:04 (roll-up removed)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3484)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Joyce Kiddell, 58:09 (End Date basis)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3489)
* [Aug 18 Weekly Sync — Kobi Kunasekaran, 58:31 (confirms automatic)](https://fathom.video/calls/787411922?timestamp=3511)
* [Aug 24 Weekly Planning — Kobi Kunasekaran, 01:11:33 (market fields + status mapping both flagged as open)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1qB7cUeJGFs_SZba9NX5R9MWKzOj8yTetmWTWoqY3gw8/edit?ouid=111290854928580430080#heading=h.2df0ngshfjzy)
* Dependencies: None identified (foundational)
* Owner (proposed): Taryn Reithofer
* Created 2026-08-20 from Brand Ambassador record documentation review.
